answer_1.quote: We propose 2kenize, a subword segmentation model which jointly considers Simplified Chinese and forecasting Traditional Chinese constructions... Our unsupervised script converter based on 2kenize shows a significant improvement over existing script converters and supervised models.
datasets: Gold standard corpus for script conversion (HK Literature, HK News, TW Literature, TW News)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models using the metrics of disambiguation error density (DED) and sentence accuracy (SA).
